summary: Ring queue + dg_push_key exported, DG_GetKey drains one event per call; JS maps required keys, ignores repeats, preventDefaults all mapped keys, focuses canvas without click, releases held keys on blur and visibilitychange hidden. Meets INPUT-01..03 as written.

findings.evidence: onKey: KEYMAP includes F5/F11/F12 and KeyR etc.; preventDefault unconditional
findings.summary: Blocks browser shortcuts (reload, Ctrl+R/W-like combos with mapped letters, fullscreen). Acceptable for gameplay but heavy-handed; consider skipping preventDefault when meta/ctrl+letter.

findings.evidence: push(): if (m && m._dg_push_key) ... else dropped, but held[code] already set
findings.summary: Keys pressed before the wasm runtime is ready are dropped yet marked held, so a later keydown would be ignored until keyup. Narrow startup window only.
